description: PID temperature and process controllers: process value, setpoints, output, PID terms, alarms, timer and programmer, input, output and comms configuration
source: Eurotherm, 3200 Series User Manual, HA028651 issue 13, Jan 2014, section 15.6

sources.title: 3200 Series PID Temperature Controllers User Manual
sources.note: section 15.6, Parameter Modbus Addresses (copy hosted by a distributor, SureHeat)

notes: Modbus RTU over EIA232, EIA485 or EIA422 (3216 only); address, baud rate and parity are set in the COMMS list (addresses 131, 12548, 12549).

Addresses are the decimal Modbus addresses of the manual. Values are 16-bit signed integers; values with decimals are sent as scaled integers, multiplied by 10 to the power of the decimal resolution configured for that value (123.5 is 1235 with one decimal), so this map gives no fixed scale.
Time values are in minutes for 'hours' resolution and in seconds for 'minutes' resolution. Native 32-bit float and time access is described in the 2000 Series Communications Handbook (HA026230).
Do not write continuously to setpoints 2, 24 and 25: they are saved to non-volatile memory with a limited number of writes. Use the remote setpoint (26) instead.
Read-only status values are marked R; the manual gives no access column, so other parameters are marked RW.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
